database_name: OPEN Spaceflight Anomaly & Lesson Repository (OSALR) — proposed schema
purpose: A shared, cross-organization record of launch/spacecraft failures and their verified corrective actions, so any team can check a new design against every prior root cause before flight — ending the 71% re-teaching rate.
design_principles: Every record keys to a controlled root-cause taxonomy so 'has this mode happened before?' is a query, not a literature search.
Two-tier access: a PUBLIC tier (mode, phase, lesson, corrective-action class) always shareable; a RESTRICTED tier (proprietary design detail) gated to members.
Fix verification is a first-class field: every corrective action must eventually be marked held / partially / did-not-hold with evidence.
Immutable, append-only, versioned — like a CVE database for spaceflight; each record gets a stable ID (OSALR-YYYY-NNNN).
Machine-readable controlled vocabularies for phase, root_cause_category, mission_type so records federate across agencies.
governance_model: Neutral steward (e.g. an IAASS/COSPAR-style body or an ISO working group) curates the taxonomy and mediates the public/restricted split; members commit to filing within N months of a mishap-board closure, mirroring aviation's ICAO ADREP/ECCAIRS and the CVE/CWE model in cybersecurity.

fields.desc: Ground / Ascent / Stage-sep / Orbit / EDL / Reentry / Operations
Controlled taxonomy (Propulsion, Avionics/Software, Structural, Human/Process, Staging/Separation, Electrical, GNC, ...)
Granular sub-mode, e.g. PROP-COPV-IGNITION, SW-UNIT-MISMATCH, STRUCT-STRUT-FAILURE
Design change / Process change / Requal / Supplier change / Redundancy
Yes / Partially / No / Too recent / N/A
Public board report / Agency inquiry / Company-FAA closure / State commission / Internal
Prior OSALR IDs sharing the failure_mode_code (the 'this happened before' link)

taxonomy_note: failure_mode_code values: see failure_mode_taxonomy.csv (8 classes incl. UNK 'undetermined/undisclosed', 28 leaf modes)
record_id_rule: OSALR-YYYY-NNNN; IDs are never reused (OSALR-2023-0002 retired: entry was not a failure)
